tools.name: write_name_in_arabic
tools.description: Writes a first name or full name in Arabic script and shows it in six Arabic calligraphy styles (Naskh, Ruqʿah, Kufi, Modern, Bold display, Ornamental) with a PNG download. Use when the user wants their name, or someone else's name, written or drawn in Arabic, Arabic calligraphy, or Arabic letters —
